Jake Thornton is a Certified Nurse-Midwife and founder of Jake's Table, a home-based Southern-fusion cooking class out of his East Lake kitchen in Atlanta. He grew up in Baltimore, Maryland and moved to Atlanta for nursing school; his mother Linda later relocated to Savannah after retirement.
